title: Counter-USV Adversarial Robustness
description: Testbed and class-kinematics consistency defense for shore-based counter-USV electro-optical detection under adversarial attack. This record is the code archive (MIT). Derived annotations, track features, and evaluation freezes are a separate dataset deposit (CC BY 4.0). Trained model weights and patch-bank tensors are withheld.
